notes.title: Horror Tale 1 has been updated! New textures and V-Sync. ⭐️
notes.notes:
We’ve prepared an update for Horror Tale 1: Kidnapper! 💀

What’s changed: 
❗️ Improved textures for even more immersive atmosphere 
❗️ Added vertical synchronization for smooth gameplay 
❗️ Fixed minor bugs and issues

Now’s the perfect time to relive this creepy story! And if you want to continue the adventure — Horror Tale 3: The Witch has recently been released. Download it on Steam! 😎
